name: AI subtitles (live)
description: Subtitles generated by Whisper while you watch, for streams and files that have none. Transcribes ahead of the playhead and caches the result. Runs on your own whisper.cpp server: nothing leaves the house.

env.name: LIVESUBS_WHISPER_URL
env.description: Base URL of a whisper.cpp whisper-server (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:18765). The plugin stays off until this is set.

env.name: LIVESUBS_LANGUAGE
env.description: Spoken language code (en, es, ...) or auto (default: detected on the first chunk, then kept).

env.name: LIVESUBS_MAX_LEAD_SEC
env.description: How far ahead of the playhead to read and transcribe (default 150).

env.name: LIVESUBS_FIRST_CHUNK_SEC
env.description: Audio in the first request, kept short so text appears quickly (default 8).
